investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Emberfield Studios (online gaming); Platform: AWS us-west-2 (zones us-west-2a/us-west-2b/us-west-2c/us-west-2d); network range 10.152.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster emberf-prod-uswest (EKS); Caching tier: self-managed Redis (cache-redis-01, maxmemory 4gb, allkeys-lru) in front of the inventory-api PostgreSQL database inventory-db-01; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
